subject: 해커스 수능영어독해 미니 모의고사 완성
title: 7회 8번 · 글의 순서 배열하기
fullPassage: Many would agree that it is hard to struggle for social justice. There are conflicting sides and uncomfortable debates along the way, which often make the fight exhausting and push people toward applying either compassion or judgment. Feeling sympathy is crucial in pursuing social justice, but compassion without a sense of judgment or a willingness to challenge a decision can cause problems. It may create an environment of silence, where destructive ideas or behaviors are tolerated out of a desire to avoid confrontation. Judgment can present substantial challenges as well unless it comes with compassion. A lack of compassion can result in the drive for justice being powered by anger or self-righteousness, which can effect an unwillingness to consider other perspectives, thereby stifling genuine dialogue. In the worst-case scenario, this approach may strengthen the unfair systems and divisive attitudes that activists are trying to change. Thus, though it may sound like a paradox, it is necessary to apply both compassion and judgment. We should approach social justice with “kindness with courage,” trying to understand others while being accountable for our beliefs.
